title: Shadow Bunny Aurora
description: A mysterious black silhouette figure with large glowing pink and green bunny ears stands centered in a dark forest. The figure wears an ornate purple Celtic knot necklace, surrounded by floating pink petals, golden coins, and colorful glowing particles, under a pink crescent moon and vibrant green-purple aurora borealis.
prompt: A dark silhouette figure with massive glowing pink and green bunny ears stands in the center of a spooky dark forest path. The figure has a completely black void face and wears an intricate glowing purple Celtic knot necklace. Pink cherry blossom petals and golden coins float through the air around it. Dramatic green and purple aurora borealis fills the night sky with a large pink crescent moon dripping liquid light above. Mystical, ethereal atmosphere with glowing particles and smoke tendrils.
